description: Unified concept library. Built from OC_Recording_Model v0.17, Option_B_Clinical v0.20 and AC_Concept_Model v0.18 on methods_02 (81a04b1).

entries.name: Observation
entries.description: The atomic abstract act of recording one fact about a subject. Root of the observation tree. Every General Observation Class (Finding, Event, Intervention) inherits this spine.

entries.name: Finding observation
entries.description: A measurement, test or examination (lab, vital sign, ECG, questionnaire).

entries.name: Event observation
entries.description: An occurrence or incident independent of planned study evaluations (adverse event, medical history, disposition).

entries.name: Intervention observation
entries.description: An investigational, therapeutic or other treatment intentionally administered (exposure, concomitant medication, procedure, substance use).

entries.name: PointComputation
entries.description: A value computed at a specific point, without reference comparison, temporal aggregation, event aggregation, or classification. Input pattern: Method-driven. The concept defines output shape only; the method determines what inputs are needed.

entries.name: Comparison
entries.description: Data expressing the relationship between two values of the same parameter. Input pattern: Concept-driven. Requires 2× Measure inputs, intrinsic to the category.

entries.name: SequenceAggregate
entries.description: A summary of an ordered series of the same parameter over time. Input pattern: Concept-driven. Requires 1× Measure input; the ordered series emerges from dimensional scoping.

entries.name: EventAggregate
entries.description: A summary of discrete event occurrences on a timeline. Input pattern: Concept-driven. Requires 1× Observation (OC layer); the event set emerges from dimensional scoping.

entries.name: Classification
entries.description: A derivation mapping value(s) to a categorical assignment. Input pattern: Concept-driven. Requires 1× any concept as input (the value being classified).

entries.name: TreatmentComparison
entries.description: A comparison of an outcome between treatment groups, producing estimated treatment effects with inference.

entries.name: SurvivalAnalysis
entries.description: An analysis of time-to-event outcomes, estimating survival patterns and comparing them between groups.

entries.name: DescriptiveSummary
entries.description: A statistical summary of a distribution within a group. No comparison between groups required. After the FHIR-datatype retargeting pass, descriptive methods produce FHIR Quantity (or Count/Duration) atomic values directly rather than structured ResultPatterns; typicallyInvolves is empty because the per-row output isn't a multi-statistic table.

entries.name: Parameter dimension
entries.description: Any concept that says which measurement an observation is of.

entries.name: Visit dimension
entries.description: Any concept that says at which visit or timepoint an observation applies.

entries.name: Event dimension
entries.description: Any concept that says which clinical event an observation is about.

entries.name: Subject
entries.description: The individual the observation is about.

entries.name: Study
entries.description: The study the observation belongs to.

entries.name: Site
entries.description: The investigational site, or a pooled group of sites.

entries.name: Visit
entries.description: The protocol-defined visit at which the observation was made.

entries.name: Timepoint
entries.description: A planned time point within a visit.

entries.name: Treatment
entries.description: The treatment, planned or actual, that the subject is assigned to or receives.

entries.name: Population
entries.description: Membership of an analysis population (analysis set).

entries.name: Parameter
entries.description: The measurement, test or question an observation is of.

entries.name: Period
entries.description: The study period an observation falls in.

entries.name: Event
entries.description: The clinical event of interest that a time-to-event or event-count concept refers to (for example death or disease progression).

entries.name: Intercurrent event
entries.description: An event occurring after treatment initiation that affects either the interpretation or the existence of the measurements associated with the clinical question of interest (ICH E9(R1)). Study intercurrent events are instances of this concept; they are defined in USDM.

entries.name: Identity
entries.description: The identity of the record and its subject

entries.name: Sequence
entries.description: Ordinal position distinguishing multiple records of the same topic for a subject

entries.name: GroupId
entries.description: Identifier grouping related records for a subject within a domain

entries.name: ReferenceId
entries.description: Identifier of a source of information (e.g. lab specimen ID, waveform UUID)

entries.name: LinkId
entries.description: Identifier linking a record to one or more records in another domain

entries.name: Topic
entries.description: Core subject matter of the recording — a test (Finding), an event term (Event), or a treatment (Intervention).

entries.name: TopicCode
entries.description: Short coded form of the topic

entries.name: TopicDecode
entries.description: Human-readable decode of the topic code

entries.name: DictionaryCoding
entries.description: Hierarchical coded-term mapping (MedDRA, WHODrug)

entries.name: PreferredTerm
entries.description: Standardised dictionary term

entries.name: HierarchyLevel
entries.description: Level in dictionary tree (SOC, HLT, PT, LLT)

entries.name: Timing
entries.description: When the recording occurred. Modelled as a FHIR effective[x] choice: an instant (point-in-time) or a period (interval). --DTC and --STDTC are the SAME occurrence/start concept (both carry dec_id C82515); only --ENDTC is distinct (the period end).

entries.name: Duration
entries.description: Elapsed time of the period (derived from start/end)

entries.name: StudyDay
entries.description: Study day of the occurrence

entries.name: RelativeTiming
entries.description: Timing relative to a reference event or timepoint

entries.name: Category
entries.description: Grouping of related recordings

entries.name: Subcategory
entries.description: Further sub-grouping within a category

entries.name: Method
entries.description: Instrument or technique used to perform the test

entries.name: Location
entries.description: Anatomical site at which the observation was performed

entries.name: Laterality
entries.description: Side of the body (left, right, bilateral)

entries.name: Directionality
entries.description: Directional qualifier of the anatomical location

entries.name: Specimen
entries.description: Biological material tested

entries.name: EvaluatorRole
entries.description: Role of the assessor who performed the test

entries.name: Position
entries.description: Subject position during performance of the test

entries.name: FastingStatus
entries.description: Subject's fasting status during the test

entries.name: Result
entries.description: The outcome of the test — answers the Topic question.

entries.name: NormalRange
entries.description: Expected range for healthy individuals

entries.name: Reference
entries.description: Reference value for the result

entries.name: Occurrence
entries.description: Whether the (pre-specified) event occurred

entries.name: PreSpecified
entries.description: Whether the event term was pre-specified on the CRF

entries.name: Severity
entries.description: Intensity of the event

entries.name: ToxicityGrade
entries.description: Standardised grade (e.g. CTCAE 1-5)

entries.name: Seriousness
entries.description: Whether the event met seriousness criteria (SAE)

entries.name: Outcome
entries.description: How the event resolved (recovered, ongoing, fatal)

entries.name: ActionTaken
entries.description: Action taken with study treatment due to the event

entries.name: Dose
entries.description: Amount of treatment administered

entries.name: DoseUnit
entries.description: Unit for the administered amount

entries.name: Frequency
entries.description: How often the amount is administered (QD, BID)

entries.name: DoseForm
entries.description: Physical form of the product (tablet, injection)

entries.name: Route
entries.description: Route / anatomical site of administration

entries.name: Indication
entries.description: Medical condition that is the reason for the treatment

entries.name: Measure
entries.description: A value produced by applying a computation to one or more source values.

entries.name: Change
entries.description: The arithmetic difference between two values of the same parameter.

entries.name: PercentChange
entries.label: Percent change from baseline
entries.description: The proportional difference between two values of the same parameter, expressed as a percentage.
examples: percent change from baseline in tumor size

entries.name: Ratio
entries.description: The quotient of two values of the same parameter.

entries.name: LogRatio
entries.description: The logarithm of the quotient of two values. Symmetric, additive scale.

entries.name: Shift
entries.description: The categorical movement between two values of the same parameter.

entries.name: PeakValue
entries.description: The highest value in an ordered series.

entries.name: TroughValue
entries.description: The lowest value in an ordered series.

entries.name: TimeToPeak
entries.description: The time at which the highest value occurs.

entries.name: TimeToTrough
entries.description: The time at which the lowest value occurs.

entries.name: AreaUnderCurve
entries.label: Area under the curve
entries.description: The integrated value over time.

entries.name: CumulativeTotal
entries.description: The running total accumulated over time.

entries.name: RateOfChange
entries.description: The rate at which a value changes over a time segment.

entries.name: HalfLife
entries.description: The time for a value to decline by half.

entries.name: LastValue
entries.description: The last observed value in an ordered series.

entries.name: FirstValue
entries.description: The first value in an ordered series.

entries.name: TimeInState
entries.description: The total time spent above or below a threshold.

entries.name: TimeToThreshold
entries.description: The time at which a series first crosses a defined threshold.

entries.name: Range
entries.description: The difference between the highest and lowest values in a series.

entries.name: EventCount
entries.label: Event count
entries.description: The number of times an event or condition occurs.

entries.name: EventRate
entries.label: Event rate
entries.description: The number of occurrences per unit of time or exposure.

entries.name: TimeToEvent
entries.label: Time to event
entries.description: The duration from a defined start to event occurrence or censoring.

entries.name: TimeBetweenEvents
entries.description: The duration between consecutive recurrent events.

entries.name: Flag
entries.description: A binary indicator evaluating a criterion (Y/N).

entries.name: Category
entries.description: A categorical grouping derived from rules.

entries.name: AnalysisVisit
entries.description: A scheduled analysis visit (label and visit number) assigned to an observation by a windowing rule that maps each observation's study day to a planned-visit category.

entries.name: Rank
entries.description: The ordinal position of a value within a defined scope.

entries.name: QuantileGroup
entries.description: A distributional bin assignment (tertiles, quartiles, quintiles).
entries.mathText: Qₖ where F(x) in bin k

entries.name: LSMeans
entries.description: Least-squares means (adjusted marginal means) per factor level or level combination

entries.name: Contrasts
entries.description: Pairwise or custom contrasts between LS means

entries.name: Type3Tests
entries.description: Type III omnibus tests, one per model term

entries.name: ParameterEstimates
entries.description: Solution for fixed effects, one row per model coefficient

entries.name: FitStatistics
entries.description: Overall model goodness-of-fit measures

entries.name: CovarianceParameters
entries.description: Estimated covariance/variance components

entries.name: TestResult
entries.description: Single overall test result

entries.name: SurvivalTable
entries.description: Life table with survival estimates at each event time

entries.name: MedianSurvival
entries.description: Median survival time per group

entries.name: EventSummary
entries.description: Summary counts of events and censoring per group

entries.name: HazardRatioEstimates
entries.description: Hazard ratios with confidence intervals

entries.name: OddsRatioEstimates
entries.description: Odds ratios with confidence intervals

entries.name: LandmarkEstimates
entries.description: Estimated survival probability at stated landmark times, per group.
